title.en: Read a recipe's steps in English and Arabic, exporting nothing

goal.en: Every example recipe carries its text in two languages under one process graph. List the recipes, read koshari's titles and first step in both, and confirm a second recipe follows the same shape. Nothing is written anywhere; a researcher reads.

note.en: The hub plans nine example recipes, all Egyptian home cooking.
Koshari: one id, names and step text in en and ar, the same node ids in both.

expect.text.en.title: Koshari
expect.text.ar.title: كشري
expect.text.en.steps.n1: Bring the lentils and water to the boil.

note.en: The Arabic step for the same node n1.
Shakshuka has the same shape; its id carries the example- prefix.

outcome.en: You can study bilingual recipe text against one machine-readable process graph without touching any household or execution data. Next: 099 validates a recipe as a publisher would.
